name: Goal-driven execution
purpose: Keep the business outcome in sight.
description: Turn an ambition into a clear result, a next action, and a way to see progress.
example: Example: define what a useful first automation should accomplish before adding features.
concept_th: มุ่งสู่เป้าหมาย

name: Angle agents
purpose: See a challenge from several perspectives.
description: Look at the same question through different professional or user perspectives to uncover overlooked trade-offs.
example: Example: review an AI support workflow from the customer, operations, and engineering viewpoints.
concept_th: มองหลายมุม

name: MCP orchestration
purpose: Coordinate tools around a shared goal.
description: Connect the roles of tools and information sources into a coherent workflow with clear boundaries.
example: Example: plan how an approved knowledge source and a drafting tool should work together.
concept_th: กระจายและประสานความคิด

name: Chain of verification
purpose: Check a claim against its evidence.
description: Break a complex answer into checkable claims and inspect the evidence behind the parts that matter.
example: Example: verify names, dates, and source support before sharing a research summary.
concept_th: ตรวจเทียบหลักฐาน

name: Spec before build
purpose: Make the intended outcome explicit.
description: Describe what a system should do, where its boundaries lie, and what would count as a useful result.
example: Example: agree on inputs, outputs, and acceptance criteria for a small prototype.
concept_th: สร้างแบบจำลองก่อนทำ

name: Subagent fanout
purpose: Explore independent tasks in parallel.
description: Divide a broad problem into independent parts, then bring the findings back into one coherent result.
example: Example: explore user needs, integration options, and evaluation methods at the same time.
concept_th: แยกคิดพร้อมกัน

name: Grounded synthesis
purpose: Bring sources together without losing them.
description: Combine relevant evidence into a useful explanation while keeping the sources and uncertainties visible.
example: Example: compare several documents and clearly separate agreement, conflict, and missing information.
concept_th: รวมความคิดบนฐานหลักฐาน

name: Decision card
purpose: Make the trade-offs easy to inspect.
description: Put the question, options, evidence, and trade-offs in one concise view that supports a deliberate choice.
example: Example: compare a manual process, a rule-based automation, and an AI-assisted workflow.
concept_th: ตัดสินใจอย่างใคร่ครวญ

name: Hindsight review
purpose: Judge a result against the original question.
description: Revisit a conclusion without quietly rewriting the expectations to fit what happened.
example: Example: compare a pilot result with the success criteria agreed before the trial.
concept_th: ต้านอคติการมองย้อนหลัง

name: Choose a skill
purpose: Find a useful place to start.
description: Match a challenge to a suitable way of thinking or working before moving into detailed execution.
example: Example: decide whether the next step needs planning, exploration, or evidence checking.
concept_th: เลือกจุดสนใจ

name: Environment setup
purpose: Prepare the context for focused work.
description: Make the working environment and relevant context clear enough to support the task ahead.
example: Example: identify the project context and available tools before beginning an engineering session.
concept_th: สร้างบริบทสนับสนุน

name: Task offload
purpose: Hand over a well-defined piece of work.
description: Reduce cognitive load by giving a bounded task a clear outcome, useful context, and a review point.
example: Example: delegate an isolated implementation task with explicit acceptance criteria.
concept_th: ฝากภาระความจำ

name: Constraint discovery
purpose: Learn what the system must respect.
description: Use a mismatch or failed result to identify the constraint that was missing from the original understanding.
example: Example: turn a failed import into an explicit validation requirement for the next attempt.
concept_th: รู้ขอบเขตข้อจำกัด

name: Context thrift
purpose: Keep the useful context close.
description: Distill working information so the next step has the essentials without repeating everything.
example: Example: carry forward the current goal, decisions, and open questions after a long session.
concept_th: ใช้ความจำทำงานอย่างคุ้มค่า

name: Calibrated inference
purpose: Keep assumptions visible.
description: Bridge a gap in the available information with a clearly labeled inference, while preserving what remains uncertain.
example: Example: outline a tentative workflow while marking integration details that still need confirmation.
concept_th: อนุมานตามระดับหลักฐาน

name: Resolve a deadlock
purpose: Find a way forward when options clash.
description: Reframe a disagreement to reveal new information, alternatives, or a useful next experiment.
example: Example: turn an architecture debate into a small test that can distinguish the options.
concept_th: ยืดหยุ่นทางความคิด

name: Dual-agent debate
purpose: Give a proposal a thoughtful challenge.
description: Explore contrasting arguments around a proposal so that strengths, weaknesses, and unresolved questions become clearer.
example: Example: compare the case for a simpler workflow with the case for a more capable agent.
concept_th: คิดจากมุมที่แตกต่าง

name: Skill sequencing
purpose: Put the next steps in a useful order.
description: Arrange different ways of working into a sequence that fits the current problem and dependencies.
example: Example: clarify the goal, gather evidence, draft a solution, then review the result.
concept_th: จัดลำดับการทำงาน

name: Enhancement engine
purpose: Improve what matters most.
description: Examine an existing result for focused improvements that make the work more useful and complete.
example: Example: refine a prototype around the point where users struggle most.
concept_th: พัฒนาอย่างต่อเนื่อง

name: Evaluate and improve
purpose: Turn feedback into a better next version.
description: Compare an output with a clear expectation, identify a gap, and use the feedback to guide a revision.
example: Example: review a generated answer for source support and clarity, then address the weakest part.
concept_th: ตรวจทวนและปรับความคิด

name: Evidence manifest
purpose: Keep the proof easy to trace.
description: Organize supporting material so someone can find what backs a claim or a completed piece of work.
example: Example: gather the relevant sources and check results for a prototype review.
concept_th: สืบย้อนร่องรอยหลักฐาน

name: Pause and resume
purpose: Keep coordinated work under control.
description: Think about where a group of tasks can pause safely and what context is needed to continue.
example: Example: pause several workstreams while a shared dependency is being clarified.
concept_th: หยุดและควบคุมการทำงาน

name: Plan mode
purpose: Look ahead before taking action.
description: Map the intended steps, dependencies, and unknowns before beginning a piece of work.
example: Example: outline an AI pilot from the initial question through a small evaluation.
concept_th: คิดล่วงหน้า

name: Pre-registered triggers
purpose: Set decision criteria before the result.
description: Make the conditions for continuing, changing direction, or stopping explicit in advance.
example: Example: agree on the evidence needed to expand a pilot before seeing its results.
concept_th: กำหนดเงื่อนไขไว้ก่อน

name: Scope bridge
purpose: Connect related contexts clearly.
description: Bring relevant ideas from one area into another while making the relationship and limits explicit.
example: Example: connect a business requirement with the engineering decisions it affects.
concept_th: เชื่อมบริบท

name: Seed expansion
purpose: Grow a useful lead into a wider view.
description: Start from a known idea or source and explore related questions that may improve understanding.
example: Example: use one promising workflow as a starting point for investigating adjacent use cases.
concept_th: ขยายความคิดเชื่อมโยง

name: Skill inspection
purpose: Look closely at how a capability is defined.
description: Read a capability with focused attention to its purpose, expectations, and limits.
example: Example: inspect whether a tool or skill actually fits the task before relying on it.
concept_th: เจาะจุดตรวจสอบ

name: Triad techniques
purpose: Examine a problem through three lenses.
description: Use three complementary perspectives or techniques to reveal different aspects of the same problem.
example: Example: consider a proposed automation through usefulness, feasibility, and risk.
concept_th: ตรวจด้วยสามมุม

name: Structured Thai output
purpose: Make the answer clear in Thai.
description: Organize ideas into a Thai-language response that is easier to read, compare, and act on.
example: Example: turn a technical analysis into a concise Thai decision brief.
concept_th: จัดความคิดให้ชัด

name: The crystallizer
purpose: Turn scattered thinking into a clear takeaway.
description: Distill a discussion into the durable idea, decision, or useful pattern that should carry forward.
example: Example: capture the key lesson from a prototype review in a concise working principle.
concept_th: กลั่นความคิดให้ชัด

name: Context handoff
purpose: Carry the important context forward.
description: Summarize the goal, decisions, evidence, and next steps so work can continue with less context loss.
example: Example: prepare a compact handoff for the next engineering session.
concept_th: ส่งต่อบริบทไม่สูญหาย

name: Watcher
purpose: Keep attention on important changes.
description: Maintain focused awareness of a process and the signals that may deserve a closer look.
example: Example: identify which changes in a running workflow should prompt a review.
concept_th: เฝ้าตรวจอย่างมีสมาธิ

name: Workflow blueprint
purpose: Give the work a practical structure.
description: Translate a goal into a coherent outline of steps, responsibilities, and expected outputs.
example: Example: map how a request moves from intake through review to an approved action.
concept_th: วางโครงก่อนลงมือ

name: Workflow execution
purpose: Move from a plan to the next action.
description: Follow a defined sequence of work while keeping its intended outcome and checkpoints visible.
example: Example: work through a small implementation plan and review the result at each checkpoint.
concept_th: เริ่มและเดินงานจริง
